plugins.name: build-standards
plugins.description: Open build standards for 13 back-office workflows: Database Reactivation, Debtor Chasing, Booked After Hours, Quote Out, Rent Arrears, Fire Service Pack, Advice File, Multi Site Conformance, Cited Answer, Compliance Calendar, Invoice Check, Rejected Pack, Knowledge Graph. Each carries ordered checks, object schemas, a conformance checklist and a pass test.
